slides.title: "This one's a quick one."
slides.body: Eight minutes. You will remember every single one of them.

slides.title: "Light and fast."
slides.body: It will be neither. You'll know by round two.

slides.title: "Scale as needed."
slides.body: You will need to. Probably earlier than you think.

slides.title: "Last round!"
slides.body: For you, it's the last round. For half the class, there are two more.

slides.title: "Grab a partner."
slides.body: Not your usual partner. We saw you two talking through the warm-up.

slides.title: "Should feel good today."
slides.body: It won't. But you'll feel great at 9am.
